name: Folio geometric isometric
description: The production Folio project-icon direction: flat, geometric, isometric, spare, and circle-safe.
promptTemplate:
Create one portfolio project icon.

Subject brief:
{{subject}}

Style contract:
Flat geometric isometric tile icon, not a scene. Strict simple isometric geometry: one dominant silhouette and at most two small supporting forms. Use only this Folio palette target: #FAFAFA, #E4E4E7, #71717B, #18181B, #CBFBF1, #00BBA7. One thin zinc outline is allowed only where a complex form needs it. No texture, halftone, distressed or grungy treatment, lighting, cast shadows, gradients, gloss, bevels, photorealism, pseudo-text, labels, letters, logos, or warm, blue, or purple accent colors. Solid #FAFAFA background intended as a circular field. Keep every critical part within the central 70 percent of the canvas, circle-safe with a 15 percent margin. It must remain legible at 80, 96, and 112 pixels.
